name: rizin-windows-re
description: Analyze native binaries and memory dumps with portable Windows x64 Rizin, three decompilers, YARA, and FLIRT.

interface.shortDescription: Analyze binaries and memory dumps with Rizin.
interface.longDescription: A Windows x64 CLI toolkit and skill for binary inspection, memory-dump analysis, RetDec/Ghidra/jsdec decompilation, YARA scanning, and FLIRT signatures. The skill downloads a verified portable runtime from GitHub Releases when needed.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this binary or memory dump with Rizin.
